skillFull: Hydrangeas start growing at certain intervals. While running in the hydrangeas(sic) field, Hydrangea Party Jellies appear mid-air. Collecting them will create circles of Hydrangea Flower Jellies. Jumping on a bed of hydrangeas will make the Cookie bounce up slightly into the air, granting Hydrangea Bounce Points. Level Up for more points for Hydrangea Flower Jellies and more Hydrangea Bounce Points.
story: From the richest of soil, watered by the summer drizzle, a rich collection of hydrangeas were picked with care. These exceptional flowers were used to adorn this Cookie! Her manners and flowers caught the eye of the one sitting atop the Lotus Palace and ever since, Hydrangea Cookie has attended to the greatest entity of the land. Though she seems quite busy carrying scrolls and parchment here and there, she always makes time to watch the flowers! In fact, she'll drop everything to adore a bed of flowers at any chance. But Hydrangea Cookie, weren't you in the middle of something important? Duties can wait! Come sun or rain, there's always time to adore the flowers. And according to her, every Cookie gets soggy from time to time. What does it matter if you become soggy today or tomorrow? Soggy or not, the hydrangeas will always find a way to bloom. Just go with the flow, she smiles, as droplets of water hang upon her long lashes.
